source_text: fore-teón; p. -teóde; pp. -teód To pre-dispose, pre-ordain; prædisp&o-long;n&e-short;re, præord&i-short;n&a-long;re :-- Swá ðé bearn weorþaþ geboren syððan, ða ylcan ic ǽr fóreteóde ecce n&a-long;tio fili&o-long;rum tu&o-long;rum quibus disp&o-short;sui, Ps.
